description: Function receiving `{ store, options, pinia, app }`, run once per store. Registered with `pinia.use(plugin)`.
Observes state changes with `(mutation, state)`. Options: `flush` (`'pre'` by default) and `detached`.
Hooks into every action call with `name`, `args`, `after` and `onError`.
Interface to augment so custom store options (like `persist`) type-check.
Makes a Pinia instance active so stores can be used outside components, e.g. in unit tests.
From `@pinia/testing`: stubs actions with spies and accepts `initialState` for component tests.
